findings.title: Empty is not constructed as current-directory deletion for normal personal/public bins
findings.detail: Selected rows use remove({paths}). Empty personal/public call rdelall()/cleanPubRecycle() with no arguments, including when currentPath is nested. Only the external/SMB cleanDir branch carries explicit root/directory paths. The UI warning applies to the delete dialog; do not promise a group-scoped or recoverable cleanup.

findings.title: Search original restore does not reproduce the personal SMB/external merge_restore dispatch
findings.status: static branch difference; runtime consequence unknown
findings.detail: Personal openDialog switches to restoreFile for external overview or module=extdev. Search recycleOpenDialog chooses only pubRestore/mrestore based on dirInfo.from. No external override or merge/overwrite flag is carried through search.

findings.title: Slow recycle search drops size/order/shared_only filters
findings.status: static parameter omission; server interpretation unknown
findings.detail: search builds order_by,min_size,max_size,shared_only, but recycle path detection selects noIndexSearch, which omits those fields. Type filtering survives as ftype10/100 or concrete selected ftype. No recycle request carries a storage selector or arbitrary shared-user filter. Username is explicit only inside the type6 source-discovery JSON.

findings.title: Same-name overwrite and directory merge policy are not implemented by these callsites
findings.detail: Original restore sends paths only; alternate-location restore sends paths and to (plus conditional hash-check option), restore-all sends paths only. There is no conflict preflight, overwrite/merge/force argument, or local collision decision in these methods. merge_restore is an endpoint name, not proof of how conflicting files or folders are handled. task continue ignore1/0 is a resume decision, not a proven overwrite option.

findings.title: External overview filters the roots that bulk operations act upon
findings.status: static observation; completeness depends on server results
findings.detail: type6 roots each receive a start0,size20 preview. Roots with empty fileList, including failed preview requests, are removed from extDevRecycleList. Empty/restore-all use this filtered root array. More appears only when reported total>20. This is not evidence that the overview contains every server recycle source.

findings.title: Search async-task completion has a local evidence gap
findings.detail: Search handleSyncApi adds async results to syncTasks, but no loopTasks/cancelTask/continueTask definitions or taskbyids call are found in 43549 or its selected 58301 mixin. Personal/public components do define their polling loop. Global handlers or server synchronous responses may affect behavior; no runtime failure is asserted.

transport.summary: Default axios timeout30000ms. Conditional clusterHost prefix/withCredentials. For object-data POST requests append missing plat=web,version,device_id,device,_l; usual form POST path additionally token,nasid. Preserve undefined-data/no-argument distinction: appendParams only operates when typeof data is object, so do not fabricate a body/auth envelope for no-argument wrappers. POST URL gets &rnd=<time_random>&webagent=v2, using ? if no existing query. Arrays form-encode as key[]=encodeURIComponent(item); scalar values encodeURIComponent(value). Response code200 or S000200 produces success=true, failures normalize to {code,message,reason,success:false,data?}. File/search list rows normalize is_dir/is_sys/nshare and infer ftype.

same_path_aliases.difference: tT injects show_hidden and mac _linux sort; recycle V does not. No recycle caller of tT demonstrated.

layout.description: Default link /.recycle/my; public /.public_recycle link added when isMaster==1 unless onlyTab=public explicitly selects public-only sidebar. This is frontend visibility, not server authorization. Settings link is rendered.

storage.description: Pool predicate: /^(sata|esata|nvme)\d+$/ or /^zenith_\w+$/. storageNamesMap labels root names; storagePools,RootPath,publicSwitch and nas.usbList/extNamesMap come from store. No new recycler-specific storage inventory API is shown.

shared_users.description: Search consumes nshare,share_user_name,ext to display source and restrict generic shared-file actions. No arbitrary-user enumeration/filter request in scoped recycle components. Public/group recycle is distinct from NAS nshare (share-to-user).

source_discovery.description: samba roots label pool-user; other source types label external-device-name. Local-app/external tabs are frontend source distinctions; not a request parameter named pageIndex.

snapshot.description: Components are reused under browseSnap recycle/groupRecycle. Snapshot UI delegates handleFileActions with {checkedList,action:"download"|"copy",cb}; these events are not attributed to recycle HTTP routes without following global handlers. No mutation validation performed.

shared_chunks.description: 86742: empty/display component31096; its downloader API14530 is shared-selector dependency only. 572:68764 file-type/icon helpers and image assets, not recycle HTTP policy. 66758:qs and side-channel helpers; no recycle endpoint declaration observed. 42909:sidebar91886. 32656:virtual-scroll24591. 33193:sorting83337. 85759:58301 open-with mixin. 48605/76670 archive dialogs co-loaded by search but unrelated archive operations excluded.

async_completion.description: Action envelopes use data.otype and data.task; async queues task.id, poll1000ms, calculate progress, treat removed/done/fail (or absent task) as terminal. Fail counts distinguish partial/all failure. Closing dialog sends no cancel request; cancel confirms and sends taskdel. Pause Ignore/Continue sends ignore1/0.

warnings.description: Both selected deletion and empty action open the same delete dialog, requiring removeFile via Delete immediately button. Personal nonroot extdev uses chedishanc_911de2 instead of general key. Exact localized prose was not located in scoped scripts; no invented quotation. Server data recovery/retention is unknown.

settings.description: UI days1,3,7,30,90; off=-1; my/public cycle initial day30 with off radio. Positive server values enable, nonpositive display fallback30/off. isMaster controls public UI and field inclusion. Watchers can save when radio values change after get; actual request timing not observed.

unknowns: All server authorization, filesystem behavior, API availability, retention scheduling and response guarantees remain untested.
No same-name overwrite/file-vs-folder conflict/merge atomicity or rollback semantics established.
No-argument public cleanup could affect more than current group; server scope must not be inferred from currentPath.
Directory source previews and filtered root lists are not a complete server inventory.
Search data fields that appear only in generic indexed branch are not promoted to guarantees for slow recycle responses.
